name: Paul Schwarzenberger
title: Cloud Security Engineer
bio: Paul Schwarzenberger is a cloud security architect and engineer, leading security engagements and cloud migration projects for customers across sectors including financial services and Government. He has in-depth enterprise experience and certifications across all three major cloud platforms - AWS, Azure and GCP. He created OWASP Domain Protect, widely used amongst organisations as an open-source platform to prevent subdomain takeover, and the open-source Serverless CA. Paul is a regular speaker at security and cloud conferences, including fwd:cloudsec, OWASP Global AppSec, SANS CloudSec Next and Security BSides.
